decision.observation: Eagle Warrior selected again, same state: 28 Melee, 2/2 Movement, 'A unit needs orders.' Action bar visible with move, shield, loop, and fortify-until-healed buttons at bottom center. Right arrow key had no effect on unit movement. Pottery 9 turns, Code of Laws 15 turns.
decision.hypothesis: Arrow keys pan the camera rather than move units in Civ VI. The 'F' key should fortify the warrior, giving it orders and allowing the turn to progress.
decision.memory: Arrow keys do not move units. Blue exclamation button re-selects the unit. Map tile clicks consistently deselect rather than move the warrior. Try F key for fortify to assign orders and clear the needs-orders state.
